visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with black hair and glasses wearing a black-and-white patterned polo shirt sits at a desk. He holds a small USB drive in his hand and looks toward a laptop. The lighting is bright and indoor. (2) A close-up shot shows the man successfully inserting the USB drive into a port on the side of a laptop or hub on the first attempt. (3) The man adjusts his glasses and looks upward with a satisfied and relaxed facial expression. (4) The scene cuts to the man lying on a white couch with a pink eye mask. He wakes up, removes the mask, and stretches his arms while looking at the camera. (5) A close-up of a smartphone screen shows an alarm set for 7:00 AM. (6) The man sits up on the couch, looking refreshed and happy. (7) The scene shifts to a restaurant buffet area. The man is holding a white plate, looking expectantly at a food station. (8) A close-up shows a chef placing fresh oysters on a counter. (9) The man reacts with surprise and delight, gesturing toward the food. (10) The man walks toward the entrance of a restaurant with a sign that reads 'INPARADISE 饗饗'. (11) He stands in front of a wooden slatted wall and talks to the camera, gesturing with his hands. (13) Close-ups of various food items are shown: a large raw oyster, oysters grilling on a mesh, a dessert in a glass with a spoon, and a variety of dim sum including cute animal-shaped buns. (14) The man is shown eating the oyster and the dessert, closing his eyes to savor the taste. (15) A close-up of a puff pastry soup being broken into with a spoon. (16) The man holds the soup bowl and talks enthusiastically to the camera. (17) The video ends with him holding a small steamer basket with an animal-shaped bun, smiling and inviting the viewers.
